items.text:
I went to see Dr. Sarah. She did PRP and CO2 laser restoration on my face. I won't show photos right now because I'm healing. I live in Nevada and traveled to Mexico.
I've been visiting her for about three or four years for different modalities. It's incredible.
Check it out!
items.name: Rita B.

items.text: I was referred to Dr. Salas Mónica Garibay Silver, Medical Tourism Liaison, who has helped me on numerous occasions to find the right doctor, hospital, or related services for my needs. Dr. Salas and her team are kind and professional. After my skin consultation for several issues, Dr. Salas provided me with a written plan to address each one with therapies and medications. This is the first time I've done this, as most doctors explain how they will treat my problems, but there's rarely such a detailed plan. My first therapy was with nurse Claudia, who was very detailed both in her explanation of the treatment and in the follow-up. I must say I am very satisfied and highly recommend Dr. Salas and her team.
